about: Adapter between the proof phases and operations that other fronts (M renderer, N resources, coordinator) are still adding. `op` and `args` are PROPOSALS: after integration the coordinator edits the real op name and argument names here (`$name` is replaced by the phase's value; a null value drops the key). A phase sends the real request; `unknown_operation` makes that phase BLOCKED (exit 3), never PASS. No rule of the editor lives in the harness.

plan.result_contract: ScenePlan::to_json (docs/features/scene-plan.md): camera.position/target/fovDeg, nodes[].id/worldMatrix, layers[].nodeId back to front, resources[].assetId/usedBy, required capabilities
plan.needs: scene.plan { scene, frame } through the shared parser (ops::parse_op) answering ScenePlan::to_json, plus the admission gates (temporal_issues/edit_join_issues) before it answers

render_frame.result_contract: same shape as render.frame's `frame`: png (file that exists), probes = [[r,g,b,a],...] in request order, inspected=true (a frame answered without readback is NOT a match), plus the identity of the resources used (assetId -> content hash)
render_frame.needs: scene.render { scene, frame, width, height, out?, probes?, resources_root? } drawing the ScenePlan with resources resolved by assetId from an approved root (never by absolute path), answered only after the frame is drawn, with a typed error for unresolved resources/missing capability

export.result_contract: exported file readable by ffprobe with `frames` frames at the bundle's fps; frame i comparable with scene.render of the same frame
export.needs: directed-scene export (BL008) reusing the plan and the resource binding of scene.render; this round only prepares the seam

lose_context.result_contract: a way to force WEBGL_lose_context mid-session and restore it, as scripts/viewport-lifecycle-proof.py does with a scratch runtime page
lose_context.needs: the scene renderer must go through the same `frame.render` path of the runtime page that the lifecycle proof triggers, so the existing trigger works unchanged
